title: Kingfisher
description: One tap to fly. A kingfisher over a lake at dawn, stone pillars rising from the water and hanging from the mist, and a day that turns as the run gets long: dawn to noon to dusk to stars. The physics is fixed-step and deterministic, the difficulty eases in over sixty pillars and is proved fair in tests by a player that must clear two hundred, a gentle wind arrives after forty, and the hitboxes forgive a graze. Medals at 10, 25, 50 and 100; your best score goes on the leaderboard. Built in three.js, everything procedural.
